M-INTEGRATIONS.NAME: Optional integrations registry
M-INTEGRATIONS.purpose: Detect, version-check and describe optional external tools (Octocode, Archify) behind ADR-9, so core gates stay deterministic, offline and dependency-free while adapters can add depth.
M-INTEGRATIONS.annotations: <export-parseVersionRange PURPOSE="Space-separated comparator list (>=0.29 <0.30, >=3.2 <4) into typed comparators." />

CrossLink.relation: integrations.* defaults and validation live in the project config (ADR-5)
Octocode adapter consumes resolveIntegration and the scrubbed child env
doctor prints the integrations row and only actionable findings

contract.purpose: Report whether Octocode/Archify are available, compatible and enabled — without ever executing an integration feature or writing to the project.

param.name: root
param.description: Project root used for config-relative bin paths.

param.name: config
param.description: Effective config with the integrations block.

param.name: env
param.description: Optional env override for tests (defaults to process.env).

param.name: status
param.description: killSwitch, octocode/archify {enabled, required, available, supported, bin, source, version, expectedRange, timeoutMs, checked, hint, error}.

param.name: findings
param.description: INTEGRATION_UNAVAILABLE/UNSUPPORTED_VERSION (info or warning), INTEGRATION_INVALID_OUTPUT/TIMEOUT notes in adapter output.

error.description: Invalid integrations.* values — exit 2 via M-CONFIG; probe failures are findings, never exceptions.

notes.note-1: ADR-9: allowlist only, argv-only, shell:false, timeouts, scrubbed env; external output is untrusted data and is never executed.
notes.note-2: Pinned tested ranges: octocode >=0.29 <0.30, archify >=3.2 <4. Out-of-range tools are reported, never used.
notes.note-3: MYGRACE_INTEGRATIONS=off disables every adapter for reproducible CI (release gate G13); the status command itself always exits 0.
notes.note-4: No network in detection: only a --version probe; the adapter's MCP session uses the same scrubbed env.
